title: Is the Pope Atheist?
coreMove: Read belief by behavior under exposure while avoiding cheap accusation as the main point.
sourcePressure: Stated doctrine can be less informative than institutional action and revealed preference under consequence.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Making the provocative title a hypocrisy takedown instead of a revealed-preference test.

sourceAnchors.name: Is the Pope Atheist?
sourceAnchors.detail: The frozen title and sidecar support a distinction between stated belief and revealed preference inside institutional religion.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The question should behave like a diagnostic, not an insult: what would the institution do if it truly carried the belief as cost?
